g.text: ERROR-STRUCTURE COMPARISON / OLD LOSS COEFFICIENTS HELD FIXED

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #182d40

g.text: What changes when tract errors persist?

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526171

g.text: New-city evaluation; same structural draws, city maps and calibration splits. Models are refitted.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263f53

g.text: Each endpoint has the same residual variance in both designs. Loss coefficients are held fixed.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607181

g.text: Dots average the within-replication SD of 20 city MSEs over five replications. These are not standard errors.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607181

g.text: 28 paired calibration tracts + 252 test tracts per city. All methods use stable acquisition pairs. W targets are noise-free conditional means.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607181

g.text: Variance normalizers are recomputed from each fitting sample. W targets exclude both residual components.
